{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the right to organize and collectively bargain is a fundamental American value.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Every American should have a voice on the job and a chance to negotiate for a fair day's pay after a hard day's work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to fight for the right of all workers to organize and join a union.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unions helped build the greatest middle class the world has ever known.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Union work resulted in the 40-hour workweek and weekends.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Union work resulted in paid leave and pensions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Union work resulted in the minimum wage and health insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Union work resulted in Social Security and Medicare.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for labor laws that provide a fair process for workers to choose union representation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for labor laws that facilitate the collective bargaining process.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for labor laws that strengthen remedies for violations of the law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for collective bargaining rights for police officers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for collective bargaining rights for nurses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for collective bargaining rights for firefighters.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for collective bargaining rights for emergency medical technicians.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for collective bargaining rights for teachers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight for collective bargaining rights for other public sector workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will vigorously oppose “Right to Work” efforts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will vigorously oppose “paycheck protection” efforts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will vigorously oppose “Save our Secret Ballot” measures whenever they are proposed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
